decision_standard: All manuscript empirical figures/results must trace to actual observed dataset records and executed model outputs; any synthetic data arms or fabricated numerical examples are prohibited as real-data evidence.

confirmed_prohibited.action: Exclude GAN-source comparisons/figures/metrics from the publication manuscript under the strict real-data-only policy. Retain code in GitHub with restricted/archived status for traceability; replace manuscript with fully observed-data benchmark if needed.

require_provenance_review.reason: Numerically measured metrics were obtained using a synthetic-data training arm, so do not qualify as real-data-only evidence.

rules_for_all_chapters: Empirical data must be authentic real-world recorded observations, cited and provenance-checked.
Real-data model predictions and measured metrics must come from actual code execution, not hand-specified vectors.
Model-generated or augmented images must never be mistaken for genuine observations; synthetic replacement training datasets are prohibited in certified examples.
Every figure/table is linked to committed code, named source dataset, split counts, actual raw metrics/predictions, and hash or verifiable GitHub asset.
No unit can be certified merely because its code compiles or a source file exists.
Explanatory architecture drawings are not experimental figures and must not contain fabricated numerical results.
